top_signals.title: Warsh Is Closer to Waller on Fed Policy, Gopinath Says
top_signals.summary: Gita Gopinath, former IMF deputy managing director, says Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has to "walk the talk" when it comes to bringing inflation down to its target of 2%. She says Warsh is closer to Fed Governor Christopher Waller on monetary policy. Waller is calling for a half-point hike in December.  (Source: Bloomberg)
